answer: The juniper counter is kept in jade and spiral exposes each reset. An hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 36 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 36 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 302 aliases cost 395 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
